table.name: museum
table.purpose: Lookup table of museums; each row is one museum, referenced by the visit and visitor tables.

col_001.name: museum_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique museum identifier referenced by visitor.col_003, visit.col_001 and visit.col_002.

col_002.name: museum_name
col_002.description: Unique human-readable name of the museum.

col_004.name: year
col_004.description: Four-digit year 2000-2012, likely the museum's opening/founding year, though it could be another event year (e.g., renovation).

table.name: visit
table.purpose: Junction/transaction table recording individual visits by visitors to museums, with an amount (likely ticket price or total spend) per visit. Each row is one visit event linking a museum to a visitor.

col_001.name: museum_id
col_001.description: Identifier of the museum visited. References museum.col_001 (many-to-one); lookup confirms museum names such as 'Capital Plaza Museum', 'ZirMed Gateway Museum'.

col_002.name: visitor_id
col_002.description: Identifier of the visitor making the visit. Although it also statistically matches museum.col_001, the join to visitor.col_001 (lookup shows person names like 'Arjen Robben', 'Rafael van der Vaart') is the semantically correct reference. Declared VARCHAR but contains integers.

col_003.name: visit_id
col_003.description: Unique integer per row (all 6 values distinct, range 2-24). Likely the visit's identifier, though it was not detected as the primary key. Alternative reading: a count of tickets/people, but uniqueness across all rows favors an ID.

col_004.name: total_price
col_004.description: Monetary amount per visit (range 19.98-320.44, two-decimal values typical of currency). Likely the ticket price or total amount paid for the visit; the exact basis (per ticket vs. total) cannot be determined from the data.

table.name: visitor
table.purpose: One row per visitor to a museum: the visitor's identity, their home/preferred museum, and their age. Referenced by the visit table, which records individual visits by these visitors.

col_001.name: visitor_id
col_001.description: Primary key of the visitor table; unique integer identifier for each visitor. Referenced by visit.col_002, which assigns a visit to a visitor.

col_002.name: visitor_name
col_002.description: Full name of the visitor (e.g. 'Arjen Robben', 'Rafael van der Vaart'). Unique per row; some values look like name plus descriptor ('Guti Midfielder'), suggesting free-text entry rather than a clean name field.

col_003.name: museum_id
col_003.description: Foreign key to museum.col_001, identifying the museum associated with the visitor (likely their home or primary museum). Values map to museum names such as 'ZirMed Gateway Museum' (8) and 'Capital Plaza Museum' (2).

col_004.name: age
col_004.description: Visitor's age in years; values range 25-56, consistent with adult ages. No join or other evidence confirms the unit, so this reading is plausible but not certain (could also be another person-level numeric attribute).
